audit_metadata.method: Direct code reading of the full repo (73 screens, 45 services, 30 components, 28 local migrations, schema.sql, RootNavigator.js, App.js) plus two full-batch AI research agents that independently read every screen file; several surprising findings were re-verified firsthand a second time before inclusion.
audit_metadata.not_verified: No live/production database queries were run in this audit (no credentials available in this session) beyond what the app's own internal CLAUDE.md history reports as previously verified live. No manual device/simulator run was performed.

unused_or_unreachable_names: MatchesScreen.js (import dead in RootNavigator.js; screen itself is alive, composed inside InboxScreen.js)

implemented_features: Phone OTP authentication
Onboarding questionnaire + location prompt + mandatory profile completion gate
Profiles (photos, prompts, interests, connection goals)
View another user's profile with compatibility scoring and host reputation
Unified Discover hub (search/filter/map across gatherings, communities, places, perks)
People discovery (proximity 'crossed paths' + browse, Notice/Wave, swipe cards)
Gatherings: creation wizard, capacity/waitlist, visibility scoping (everyone/friends/community/invite-only), live 'hub' experience, Q&A, feedback loop
Communities: creation, roles (creator/leader/member), calendar view, business affiliation
Friends: requests, suggestions, contacts-import matching, custom 'circles'
1:1 messaging (text/voice/photo/video/GIF/reactions/translation/disappearing messages)
Group chats (per-gathering, per-community)
Activity feed (notices, sightings, friend requests, business updates)
Gathering/community invites (social_invites, friends-only)
App referral/growth code system (separate from event invites)
Business profiles (public-facing, real follower/reputation/perk data)
Business dashboard (analytics, growth, top-member CRM drill-in, partnership request management)
Business partnership requests (gathering/community sponsorship, approve/decline)
Business perks/offers with scarcity, targeting, and group-unlock thresholds
Perk redemption with server-enforced limits
Loyalty tier display (Rewards)
Consumer Premium subscription via RevenueCat, with billing management screen
Business billing math (per-redemption/flat/hybrid contracts, monthly cron-generated invoices)
Privacy-preserving proximity (no client ever receives precise location of another person)
Maps (gathering pins, business pins, live-now highlighting)
Safety: report/block, date safety check-in with location sharing, persistent emergency contacts
Admin tools: report review, business-request review, ID-verification review
AI Create Assistant (free-text to prefilled gathering/community/business-request)
AI Concierge (premium-gated natural-language recommender)
AI Rehearsal Room (practice-conversation chat, premium-gated)
Personal analytics: Insights, Momentum, Timeline

Relationship-longevity suite: Memory Vault, Chemistry Diary, Goodbye Archive, Relationship Legacy/Library, Relationship Constitution, Emergency Kit, Stress Test, Shared Decisions, Shared Playlist, Trip Planning, Timeline Planner
Multi-language support (11 languages)
Analytics/telemetry: PostHog + Sentry

silent send-failure on 4 chat-style screens; production debug overlay ships on ChatScreen
location-preference answer collected but never used; post-signup recommendation cards all navigate identically regardless of which was tapped

deployed and structurally sound per the app's own history, but no session in that history or this audit exercised a real successful model call

partial_features.feature: Blocking safety fix / business-RPC ownership fix
partial_features.gap: both reported resolved in the app's internal history, neither independently re-verified live in this audit
client-side filter over already-fetched lists, not a real backend index

missing_features: Payment processor for business billing (invoices generated, nothing collects money)
Path to invite a non-app-user to a specific gathering/event (only a generic app referral exists)
Nudge to join the community behind a gathering just attended
Locally version-controlled schema for the majority of production tables
A dedicated business-side analytics/CRM screen beyond what BusinessDashboard already has (noted as a boundary, not confirmed missing beyond current scope)
critical_gaps: ChatScreen.js ships a production debug overlay + literal 'DEBUG:' text to real users on every message bubble
6 of 11 relationship-longevity screens are reachable only via a 13-button Alert.alert, a likely Android reliability issue for the app's stated key differentiator
~45 of ~53 real production database tables have no schema source anywhere in the git repository
Unverified live status of a previously-reported blocking-bypass safety bug in is_blocked()
Unverified live status of previously-reported business-RPC PII exposure fixes
4 chat-style screens silently drop a user's message on send failure
No payment processor exists for business billing
No proof-of-redemption mechanism for business perks
major_user_flows: Switch between consumer and business mode
business_features: Business billing (contract-based, cron-generated invoices, no payment rail)
Business analytics: dashboard stats, growth, attendee breakdown, top-member CRM drill-in
consumer_features: Dating: Notice/Wave, mutual matching, compatibility scoring
Safety tools (blocking, reporting, date check-in, emergency contacts)
technical_risks: Local repository cannot reconstruct ~85% of the real production database schema
Two large (1400+ line) single-file screens carrying significant business logic
Hardcoded backend URLs/keys inline in at least 3 component files, bypassing the shared services layer convention used elsewhere
Inconsistent admin-action integrity patterns (RPC vs. plain client update within the same screen)
Client-side, non-indexed search that will not scale gracefully with data volume growth
Deliberately wide-open RLS on gatherings/communities, with visibility enforcement living entirely in app-layer query logic
No environment-config layer; every hardcoded value in the app is a plain source-code string
Dangling dead imports in the main navigator file as a maintenance trap
